title: CSP instance from a Unique Games instance
statement: Every finite Unique Games instance determines a constraint satisfaction instance over its Unique Games template on the same variable set: its constraints are the multiset of constraints associated to all occurrences, retaining multiplicities. This multiset is nonempty, and every declared variable appears in the scope of at least one constraint.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Unique Games instance over a domain of size $q$ is given
